pin.note: verified before the shared defaults of 2026-11-04 (docs/REFACTOR.md 1-3, 7): the old alt ROM fill, no ROM path / tail check; `--altrom-fill whole` opts in to the rework

rework.name: v128

decisions.base: Dean's generic TID build (build.py TidPatch altrom: template, sites, patterns)
decisions.input: the 128K release (AY music from bank 3 in the game ISR)
decisions.strategy: altrom: hooks + table + register block at 0x386E in alt image 1 = Sinclair's 48K ROM (whole image); image 0 = the 128K ROM 0; tail in the dead stack 0xA2BD; printer buffer put back after NEXLOAD; plot hook at 28 MHz, incoming speed restored

rework.proof: PARTIAL. 3 bot walks of the 128K release (12,013 / 12,028 / 12,020 frames) on rework v128: every hook event IDENTICAL (4,684 plots, 4,695 erases, 21,245 ISR hide checks, 135 room wipes, 47 boxes), 4,713 sprite plots pixel-perfect; but 5 of 101,594 pixel tests (0xA134) read a byte where the original's own erase had left a hole (Dizzy plotted, another routine (0x906F / 0x90DE) drew over him, the eraser 0x9CA0 XOR-restored a stale undo): the build keeps that background pixel, so those tests differ (Dean's 48K build has the same property: same code); negatives: pattern nibbles, frame table, ISR hide, box hide, ISR+wipe hide detected by their own signals, the wipe hide alone is masked by the ISR hide; clock matrix 5 sites x 4 clocks = 20 cases PASS, forced 3.5 MHz exit detected; ROM paths: every ROM byte as recorded; tail never read before written; printer buffer as the snapshot after NEXLOAD
rework.note: Jon Attree's Magicland Dizzy 128K rework (2026-11-05): engine magicland128 (engines.py: the 128K snapshot), Dean's generic TID build (build.py TidPatch altrom) on the 128K release so the AY music plays; whole alt ROM image; the printer buffer (the game's bit-reverse table) put back after NEXLOAD; the plot hook's sprite uploads at 28 MHz, the incoming speed restored; a 128K copy of the TID verifier with box, pixel tests and guards; the every-site clock matrix. Recordings: bot walks on SkoolKit's C simulator. Packaged as Dizzy 4 - Magicland Dizzy (1990)(Code Masters)(128K).nxc v1.0 (pilot runs/dean_magicland_dizzy). games/magicland_dizzy.md.
